subject: science
concept: Understanding the periodic table's organization by atomic number and element properties
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Properties of Matter) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges physical element cards in order of atomic number and observes property patterns
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an element's position on the periodic table to a predicted property (metal, nonmetal, reactivity trend)
exercise.abstract: Student explains what an element's position on the periodic table reveals about its properties

misconception_flags: confuses atomic number with atomic mass when explaining periodic table organization

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
